mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (contractionary policy but strong demand) creates a feedback loop where lower discount rates amplify demand-driven equity valuations, generating positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise simultaneously
failure_condition: The interaction effect (FEDFUNDS decline × GDPC1 rise) has a rank IC < 0.03 over the 20-day horizon, or the proxies move in opposite directions contrary to expectations.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 5.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return within 5 trading days as investors anticipate labor market recovery and equity market optimism.
failure_condition: The 5-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the UNRATE crossing below 5.0%, or the drop in UNRATE is not sustained beyond the trigger point.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO over the past month signals stronger production capacity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with 20-day returns (rank IC <0.03) or the index plateaus despite sustained increases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% amplifies growth expectations, leading to stronger equity valuations and positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) despite FEDFUNDS below 4.0%, or the regime does not qualify as late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS (tightening labor market and higher rates) signals a turning point toward recovery, generating quick positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise and FEDFUNDS rise simultaneously
failure_condition: The 5-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) despite the simultaneous rise in both proxies, or the proxies move in opposite directions contrary to expectations.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDPC1 reading exceeding its previous high by 5% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting strong demand-driven growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding the threshold, or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, INDPRO crossing above 105.0 signals robust supply chain strength, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as market confidence rebuilds.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 105.0, or the regime does not qualify as post-shock recovery.
